note: The board's Status options exactly as they stood before the Needs you redesign. Restore by re-sending this list to updateProjectV2Field, ids included, which preserves every card.

options.name: Bob's Draft Notes
options.description: YOU. Private scratchpad, never read by agents. One line is enough. Drag it to Needs expanding.

options.name: Needs expanding
options.description: Agent. A one-liner. The next pass researches it and writes it out, then moves it to Needs refinement. No conversation.

options.name: Needs refinement
options.description: YOU. Run /factory-start and refine it in conversation.

options.name: Ready for spec
options.description: Agent. /factory-create-spec writes the spec and the DECISIONS table.

options.name: Needs spec approval
options.description: YOU, with the agent. Each DECISIONS row carries a recommendation; say yes or no to each, then drag it to Ready for dev.

options.name: Ready for dev
options.description: Agent. /factory-build implements the spec and opens a PR.

options.name: In review (PR)
options.description: Agent. CodeRabbit is reviewing. It moves on by itself: approved goes to Needs merging, changes requested goes back to Ready for dev.

options.name: Needs merging
options.description: YOU. CodeRabbit is happy. Read the diff and merge; the merge moves the card to Needs retro.

options.name: Needs retro
options.description: Agent. Run /factory-retro. It writes the lesson and moves the card to Done.

options.name: Stuck
options.description: YOU. Three review rounds and still not right. No command touches this column. Fix it, respec it, or close it.

options.name: Done
options.description: Retro written. The archive of finished runs, kept visible on purpose.
